extracted.intended_audience: prospective grant applicants / researchers seeking funding from Schmidt Sciences
extracted.subtask_description: FAQ and policy summary for prospective awardees describing Schmidt Sciences' mission, funding priorities (research areas and project types they seek), submission policy (no unsolicited proposals), and indirect-cost/payment rules that govern awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research focus and project type
rubrics_metrics.description: Schmidt Sciences seeks out researchers pursuing early-stage, high-risk hypotheses that address everything from basic-science questions to pressing problems facing the planet. We sow the seeds of these ideas into what we believe to be the most fertile soil—a vibrant, interdisciplinary global community, equipped with the most advanced technology, where scientists can follow their curiosity—with the goal of nurturing new ways to conduct science and growing a forest of knowledge and solutions for the world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Founded in 2024, Schmidt Sciences prioritizes research in five centers poised for revolutionary impact: AI and Advanced Computing; Astrophysics and Space; Biosciences; Climate; Science Systems. Preference is implied for early-stage, high-risk, interdisciplinary projects that leverage advanced technology and have potential for revolutionary impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indirect-costs policy (budget eligibility and limits)
rubrics_metrics.description: We require all awardees, unless otherwise agreed to in the terms of the award agreement, to refrain from using award funds to pay for any indirect costs, and there shall be no allocation of indirect costs to an award, in each case, unless expressly agreed in writing in the agreement to permit the award to be spent on indirect costs. In other words, the awardee should not include any indirect costs in an award’s budget unless expressly agreed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If an indirect-cost allocation is allowed per the award agreement, the following rules apply (unless otherwise expressly set forth in the applicable award agreement): indirect costs may not exceed 10% of the total award; the allocation rate must be approved in advance by the program manager or other office; the indirect-cost allocation must be included as a line item in the project budget.

rubrics_metrics.name: Policy on unsolicited proposals / submission process
rubrics_metrics.description: We proactively seek out grant opportunities and do not accept unsolicited proposals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prospective applicants should not submit unsolicited proposals; instead monitor and apply to open calls for proposals (link provided on the site).

rubrics_metrics.name: Organizational relationships / affiliation disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Schmidt Sciences is part of the philanthropic organizations and initiatives created and funded by Eric and Wendy Schmidt to work toward a healthy, resilient, secure world for all.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Related organizations include: Schmidt Family Foundation; Schmidt Ocean Institute; 11th Hour Racing; Remain; Schmidt Initiative for Long Covid; Agog. This contextual information may be relevant to understanding the funder's ecosystem and priorities.
